The ritual — how a session unfolds

Sessions move in soft stages: arrival and grounding, a guided breath and intention, a layered soundscape, then a gradual return with tea and space for reflection. Our intention is embodied stillness and gentle transformation.

Arrival & Grounding

Welcome, settling breathwork, orientation to the room and vocal tone bells for grounding.

Sound Journey

A woven field of resonance using crystal bowls, wind chimes, and tuned forks to invite cellular resonance and depth.

Return

Slow re-emergence, tea, and an invitation to journal or rest a moment longer.

What to expect

A sensory-first, premium environment: dimmed light, organic textiles, and careful acoustics. Expect sustained tones, subtle dynamic changes, and intentional silence. Sessions are not therapy but may support wellbeing.

Contraindications: If you are pregnant, have uncontrolled seizures, a cardiac device sensitive to vibration, or are amid a psychiatric crisis, please consult your provider before attending. Not a substitute for medical care.

Private sound sessions — singular attention

Tailored sessions in a private room or at your location. Each offering is designed for focused care: 1:1, couples, and corporate restorative soundwork. Facilitated by {{FACILITATOR_NAME}}.

Request a booking

Offerings

1:1 Private Session

A one-on-one, 75-minute immersive session. We attune the field to your needs, using harmonic gongs, metal tongue drum, and tuned forks for focused somatic release.

Flow: intake, intention, sound journey, restorative closing.

Couples Session

Shared experience in a private space — 90 minutes. Facilitated tones balance dual bodies and relational field using bowed monochord and crystal bowls for harmonized resonance.

Corporate & Team

Sound workshops and restorative sessions (30–90 minutes) to reset and recalibrate teams. Scalable onsite soundscapes with gongs, chimes, and subtle tonal textures to aid group cohesion.

What to expect in a private session

Sessions begin with a brief intake to understand intentions and sensitivities. Then a crafted sound journey follows: layered tones, microtonal adjustments, and space for integration. The session closes with a gentle reorientation and suggestions for aftercare.

What to bring: mat or yoga mat, blanket, pillow, and any items for comfort. Wear clothing you can lie still in.

Contraindications: Please disclose pregnancy, cardiac devices, or seizure history. If you are under psychiatric care or in crisis, inform us and consult your provider. Vibrational work is powerful; medical questions should be directed to your clinician.

Booking & logistics

Private sessions are held at {{VENUE_NAME}} or in some cases at your space. Travel fees may apply. Sessions require a deposit; see full terms on the rates page.

For consultations or to request an on-site corporate offering, email {{EMAIL}} or call {{PHONE}}.

See pricing & packages
